articles.title: Will anyone stop re-election of Infantino as Fifa president?
articles.summary: Little more than two months since news broke of Infantino's Fifa Forward Enterprise proposal, the chances appear slim that Gianni Infantino might be removed as president.

articles.title: NI World Cup hopes gone from 'improbable to impossible'
articles.summary: Michael McArdle admits Northern Ireland's chances of beating Portugal in a Women's World Cup play-off have "gone from improbable to impossible" after a 4-0 first leg defeat.

articles.title: Watch: Every Messi World Cup goal for Argentina
articles.summary: Watch every World Cup goal scored by Lionel Messi, as the Argentina forward retires from international football.

articles.title: England take control of World Cup play-off with win in Greece
articles.summary: England are in control of their World Cup play-off with Greece after winning the first leg 3-1 in Crete.
